title: Vehiculos conducibles de verdad: VehicleService + VehicleControl
request: Los vehiculos comprables no se movian ni se podian conducir porque los modelos plantilla de ServerStorage.DeliveryModels (Bike, Scooter, Moto, Car) estan VACIOS, sin piezas ni asiento, y la mejora de vehiculo solo aplicaba un multiplicador de velocidad al personaje. Creo dos scripts nuevos y autonomos, sin tocar el codigo existente. VehicleService (servidor) construye por codigo el vehiculo segun el nivel del jugador (Bici, Scooter, Moto, Coche) con chasis, ruedas, faros y asiento, lo aparca junto al jugador al aparecer, ofrece un ProximityPrompt 'Conducir' solo para su dueno, y lo mueve de forma cinematica y autoritaria a 60 Hz con raycast al suelo para seguir pendientes y raycast frontal para no atravesar muros (los peatones no bloquean, para poder atropellarlos). Marca el atributo OwnerUserId mientras conduces para que CarImpactService no te atropelle con tu propio vehiculo. VehicleControl (cliente) lee WASD, Shift para turbo y V para llamar al vehiculo, envia la entrada por RemoteEvent y muestra un velocimetro con los controles.

operations.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🏍 VEHICLE SERVICE · vehiculos que SI se conducen
--
-- Los modelos de ServerStorage.DeliveryModels estaban vacios,
-- asi que el vehiculo se construye aqui por codigo.
--
-- Conduccion cinematica: el chasis va anclado y el servidor lo
-- mueve con PivotTo a 60 Hz. El asiento suelda al personaje,
-- asi que viajas con el. Raycast al suelo para pendientes y
-- raycast frontal para no atravesar muros.
--
-- Controles (los envia VehicleControl): WASD + Shift turbo,
-- V para llamar al vehiculo, Espacio para bajarte.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

-- nivel 1..4 → caracteristicas
local TIERS = {
	{ name = "Bici", speed = 38, accel = 28, turn = 2.7, wheel = 1.0, size = Vector3.new(2.0, 1.0, 4.0), color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 205, 130) },
	{ name = "Scooter", speed = 48, accel = 32, turn = 2.5, wheel = 1.1, size = Vector3.new(2.3, 1.1, 4.6), color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 95) },
	{ name = "Moto", speed = 62, accel = 40, turn = 2.2, wheel = 1.3, size = Vector3.new(2.5, 1.2, 5.2), color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 95, 85) },
	{ name = "Coche", speed = 76, accel = 44, turn = 1.9, wheel = 1.6, size = Vector3.new(4.4, 1.7, 8.0), color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 155, 245) },
}

local RIDE_HEIGHT = 1.2 -- studs entre el suelo y la parte baja del chasis
local BOOST = 1.35      -- multiplicador con Shift
local BRAKE = 60        -- frenada al soltar el acelerador
local REVERSE = 0.35    -- fraccion de velocidad marcha atras
local STEER_MIN = 0.3   -- giro minimo a baja velocidad

local server = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("DeliveryServer")
local UpgradeService
if server and server:FindFirstChild("UpgradeService") then
	pcall(function()
		UpgradeService = require(server.UpgradeService)
	end)
end

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryRemotes")
if not remotes then
	remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "DeliveryRemotes"
	remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local inputEvent = remotes:FindFirstChild("VehicleInput")
if not inputEvent then
	inputEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	inputEvent.Name = "VehicleInput"
	inputEvent.Parent = remotes
end

local EXCLUDE do
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	end)
	EXCLUDE = ok and value or Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
end

local rigs = {}
local lastSummon = {}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Nivel de vehiculo del jugador (tolerante a como se guarde)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function tierOf(player)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "VehicleLevel", "Vehicle", "VehicleTier", "Vehiculo" }) do
		local value = player:GetAttribute(key)
		if type(value) == "number" and value >= 1 then
			return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 1, #TIERS)
		end
	end
	if UpgradeService and UpgradeService.GetLevel then
		for _, key in ipairs({ "Vehicle", "Vehicles", "Vehiculo" }) do
			local ok, level = pcall(UpgradeService.GetLevel, player, key)
			if ok and type(level) == "number" and level > 0 then
				return math.clamp(level + 1, 1, #TIERS)
			end
		end
	end
	return 1
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Construccion del vehiculo
------------------------------------------------------------
local function makePart(name, size, color, parent)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function buildVehicle(player, tier)
	local spec = TIERS[tier]
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Vehiculo_" .. spec.name .. "_" .. player.UserId
	model:SetAttribute("VehicleTier", tier)
	model:SetAttribute("VehicleName", spec.name)

	local chassis = makePart("Chassis", spec.size, spec.color, model)
	model.PrimaryPart = chassis

	local cabin = makePart("Cabin", Vector3.new(spec.size.X * 0.78, spec.size.Y * 0.85, spec.size.Z * 0.42), spec.color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.4), model)
	cabin.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, spec.size.Y * 0.9, -spec.size.Z * 0.1)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local wheel = makePart("Wheel" .. i, Vector3.new(0.6, spec.wheel, spec.wheel), Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38), model)
		wheel.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		wheel.CanCollide = false
		local sx = (i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
		local sz = (i <= 2) and 1 or -1
		wheel.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(sx * spec.size.X * 0.5, -spec.size.Y * 0.45, sz * spec.size.Z * 0.32)
	end

	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local lamp = makePart("Faro", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.35, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 200), model)
		lamp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		lamp.CanCollide = false
		lamp.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(sx * spec.size.X * 0.3, 0, -spec.size.Z * 0.52)
		local light = Instance.new("SpotLight")
		light.Range = 42
		light.Angle = 70
		light.Brightness = 1.6
		light.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		light.Parent = lamp
	end

	local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
	seat.Name = "VehicleSeat"
	seat.Size = Vector3.new(spec.size.X * 0.55, 0.4, spec.size.Z * 0.3)
	seat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 46)
	seat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	seat.Anchored = true
	seat.CanCollide = false
	seat.Parent = model
	seat.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, spec.size.Y * 0.55, spec.size.Z * 0.12)

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Conducir"
	prompt.ObjectText = spec.name
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = chassis

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
		if who ~= player then return end
		local char = who.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
			pcall(function()
				seat:Sit(hum)
			end)
		end
	end)

	CollectionService:AddTag(model, "Vehicle")
	return model, seat, prompt
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Suelo
------------------------------------------------------------
local function groundY(position, ignore)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = EXCLUDE
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	local result = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0), Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), params)
	if result then
		return result.Position.Y
	end
	return position.Y
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Aparcar / llamar al vehiculo
------------------------------------------------------------
local function summon(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	local tier = tierOf(player)
	local rig = rigs[player]
	if rig and (not rig.model.Parent or rig.tier ~= tier) then
		if rig.model.Parent then
			rig.model:Destroy()
		end
		rig = nil
	end
	if not rig then
		local model, seat, prompt = buildVehicle(player, tier)
		model.Parent = workspace
		rig = { model = model, seat = seat, prompt = prompt, tier = tier, yaw = 0, speed = 0, throttle = 0, steer = 0, boost = false }
		rigs[player] = rig
	end

	local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	flat = flat.Unit
	local spec = TIERS[rig.tier]
	local base = hrp.Position + flat * (6 + spec.size.Z * 0.5)
	local y = groundY(base, { rig.model, char }) + RIDE_HEIGHT + spec.size.Y * 0.5
	rig.yaw = math.atan2(-flat.X, -flat.Z)
	rig.speed = 0
	rig.throttle = 0
	rig.steer = 0
	rig.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(base.X, y, base.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, rig.yaw, 0))
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Entrada del cliente
------------------------------------------------------------
inputEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, a, b, c)
	if action == "summon" then
		if os.clock() - (lastSummon[player] or -99) < 1 then return end
		lastSummon[player] = os.clock()
		pcall(summon, player)
	elseif action == "input" then
		local rig = rigs[player]
		if rig then
			rig.throttle = math.clamp(tonumber(a) or 0, -1, 1)
			rig.steer = math.clamp(tonumber(b) or 0, -1, 1)
			rig.boost = c == true
		end
	elseif action == "exit" then
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.Sit = false
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.delay(3, function()
			if player.Parent then
				pcall(summon, player)
			end
		end)
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local rig = rigs[player]
	if rig and rig.model.Parent then
		rig.model:Destroy()
	end
	rigs[player] = nil
	lastSummon[player] = nil
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bucle de conduccion (autoritario en el servidor)
------------------------------------------------------------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if dt > 0.2 then dt = 0.2 end
	for player, rig in pairs(rigs) do
		local model = rig.model
		if not model.Parent then
			rigs[player] = nil
		else
			local spec = TIERS[rig.tier]
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local driving = hum and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsDescendantOf(model)
			if driving then
				model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
				rig.prompt.Enabled = false
			else
				model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", nil)
				rig.prompt.Enabled = true
				rig.throttle = 0
				rig.steer = 0
				rig.boost = false
			end

			local target = rig.throttle * spec.speed * (rig.boost and BOOST or 1)
			if rig.throttle == 0 then
				local drop = math.min(math.abs(rig.speed), BRAKE * dt)
				rig.speed = rig.speed - math.sign(rig.speed) * drop
			else
				local step = spec.accel * dt
				rig.speed = rig.speed + math.clamp(target - rig.speed, -step * 2, step)
			end
			local minSpeed = -spec.speed * REVERSE
			if rig.speed < minSpeed then rig.speed = minSpeed end

			if math.abs(rig.speed) > 0.1 then
				local grip = STEER_MIN + (1 - STEER_MIN) * math.clamp(math.abs(rig.speed) / spec.speed, 0, 1)
				local sign = rig.speed >= 0 and 1 or -1
				rig.yaw = rig.yaw - rig.steer * spec.turn * dt * grip * sign
			end

			local pivot = model:GetPivot()
			local forward = CFrame.Angles(0, rig.yaw, 0).LookVector
			local nextPos = pivot.Position + forward * rig.speed * dt

			if math.abs(rig.speed) > 2 then
				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterType = EXCLUDE
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model, char }
				local dir = forward * (rig.speed >= 0 and 1 or -1)
				local reach = spec.size.Z * 0.5 + 2.5
				local result = workspace:Raycast(pivot.Position, dir * reach, params)
				if result then
					local owner = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
					local isCreature = owner and owner:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
					if not isCreature then
						rig.speed = -rig.speed * 0.12
						nextPos = pivot.Position
					end
				end
			end

			local gy = groundY(nextPos, { model, char })
			local wantY = gy + RIDE_HEIGHT + spec.size.Y * 0.5
			local y = pivot.Position.Y + (wantY - pivot.Position.Y) * math.clamp(dt * 10, 0, 1)
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(nextPos.X, y, nextPos.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, rig.yaw, 0))
			model:SetAttribute("Speed", math.floor(math.abs(rig.speed) + 0.5))
		end
	end
end)

print("[Vehicle] listo — E para conducir, WASD, Shift turbo, V para llamarlo")

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🎮 VEHICLE CONTROL (cliente)
-- WASD para conducir, Shift turbo, V llama al vehiculo,
-- Espacio para bajarte. Muestra velocimetro mientras conduces.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DeliveryRemotes", 30)
local inputEvent = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("VehicleInput", 30)
if not inputEvent then
	warn("[VehicleControl] no encuentro VehicleInput")
	return
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "VehicleGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 56)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 1, -96)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 30)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = gui
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = panel

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
speedLabel.TextSize = 20
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
speedLabel.Text = "0 studs/s"
speedLabel.Parent = panel

local hintLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
hintLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
hintLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
hintLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hintLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
hintLabel.TextSize = 13
hintLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 195)
hintLabel.Text = "WASD conducir · Shift turbo · Espacio bajar"
hintLabel.Parent = panel

local function currentVehicle()
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart
	if not seat then return nil end
	local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if model and model:GetAttribute("VehicleTier") then
		return model
	end
	return nil
end

local lastThrottle, lastSteer, lastBoost = 0, 0, false

local function readInput()
	local throttle, steer = 0, 0
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then
		throttle = throttle + 1
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) then
		throttle = throttle - 1
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then
		steer = steer + 1
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) then
		steer = steer - 1
	end
	local boost = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
	return throttle, steer, boost
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
		inputEvent:FireServer("summon")
	end
end)

local acc = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	acc = acc + dt
	local vehicle = currentVehicle()
	panel.Visible = vehicle ~= nil
	if not vehicle then
		if lastThrottle ~= 0 or lastSteer ~= 0 or lastBoost then
			lastThrottle, lastSteer, lastBoost = 0, 0, false
			inputEvent:FireServer("input", 0, 0, false)
		end
		return
	end

	local throttle, steer, boost = readInput()
	if throttle ~= lastThrottle or steer ~= lastSteer or boost ~= lastBoost then
		lastThrottle, lastSteer, lastBoost = throttle, steer, boost
		inputEvent:FireServer("input", throttle, steer, boost)
	end

	if acc >= 0.1 then
		acc = 0
		local speed = vehicle:GetAttribute("Speed") or 0
		local name = vehicle:GetAttribute("VehicleName") or "Vehiculo"
		speedLabel.Text = name .. " · " .. speed .. " studs/s"
		if boost then
			speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120)
		else
			speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
		end
	end
end)
